delivery.notes: LCE is a named co-programme under MEF-UNEP MoU. Directly delivers on Paris Agreement mitigation mandate through startup acceleration.
MEF-UNEP MoU positions MEF as a UNEP delivery partner at country and regional level under Paris Agreement framework.

alignment.notes: SAFFAL's $6M blended finance facility is a direct response to the Paris Agreement's finance mobilisation imperative.

problem.notes: Paris Agreement commits India to $10.1T net zero by 2070 — but no domestic mechanism exists to channel risk capital. ICAP exists because of this gap.
